Actual production Bismillah-only recordings used by the reciter mappings.

These bytes come from the upstream-checksummed EveryAyah mirror recorded in
`docs/bismillah-content-audit.json`. The audit records original folder, filename,
mirror release, SHA-256 and Arabic ASR transcripts. Tests enforce the actual
production source hashes. Automated transcription is not human listening or
independent speaker identification. Files are named by app reciter ID here;
production caching retains each source filename.
